'''Vonak''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] home to the [[Cilare (species)|Cilare]] species which subscribed to martial values and savored combat around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. It had wide open grassy plains and was home to canine and a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] which were hunted by the warriors.

==History==
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] battle fleet attacked the planet. The natives were so assured of their own battle prowess that they proudly engaged the Yuuzhan Vong forces. The Vong quickly overpowered and exterminated the warrior race, using their deadly [[Fire Breather]]s to wipe out the species. All were lost except for the warrior, [[Arbeloa]], who despite not having contact with other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], attempted to warn others of the impending invasion. After he transmitted this warning into space, he was taken prisoner. This same battle fleet then [[Battle of Artorias|attacked]] [[Artorias]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Behind the scenes==
The planet remained unnamed until the release of the ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. [[Jason Fry]] later confirmed on his blog that Vonak is the Cilare's homeworld.
